dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Inject a fake `pydantic_ai` module (exposing `Agent` with `instrument_all`) into sys.modules alongside the opentelemetry fakes so the first try block succeeds regardless of installed extras, guaranteeing the second try/except is the seam actually driven in every CI lane.
evidence: tracing.py import block includes pydantic_ai: `from pydantic_ai import Agent` at src/rebar/llm/tracing.py:293, inside the FIRST try/except (lines 288-295) that returns False on any ImportError (line 294-295)
The second try/except containing `provider = TracerProvider()` is at src/rebar/llm/tracing.py:296-311 — reached ONLY after the pydantic_ai import at line 293 succeeds
The test's `fakes` dict (tests/unit/test_tracing.py:59-72) injects only opentelemetry.* submodules; there is NO `pydantic_ai` entry
Gating CI test job installs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui` (.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:451) — `agents` is NOT among them
pydantic-ai-slim is declared in the `agents` extra (pyproject.toml:108-133 `agents = [ ... "pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries,duckduckgo]>=1.107,<2" ]`), not in dev/reviewbot/ui

The test's only observable assertions are `assert tracing.setup_tracing(cfg) is False` and `assert tracing._CONFIGURED is False` (tests/unit/test_tracing.py:78-79), both of which are ALSO satisfied when the pydantic_ai import fails at line 293-295, so the oracle cannot distinguish the second-swallow path from the first-except path
dropped.finding: The test does not fake `pydantic_ai`, so it only reaches setup_tracing's second try/except (the provider-construction swallow it claims to cover) when the real pydantic_ai is installed. The gating CI test job installs only dev+reviewbot+ui extras (not `agents`, which carries pydantic-ai-slim), so there `from pydantic_ai import Agent` raises, the FIRST except returns False, and the second swallow is never entered — yet `assert setup_tracing(cfg) is False` still passes, so the test is regression-blind to the behavior it targets in the gating lane.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a fake pydantic_ai module to the injected `fakes`, e.g. `pa = types.ModuleType("pydantic_ai"); class _Agent: @staticmethod\n def instrument_all(): None; pa.Agent = _Agent; fakes["pydantic_ai"] = pa`, so `from pydantic_ai import Agent` at tracing.py:293 always succeeds and execution reaches the raising `TracerProvider()`.
